title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: To determine if a set of columns is linearly independent, consider if any column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others. If not, they are independent.

title: Span of Columns
text: The span of a set of columns is the set of all possible linear combinations of those columns. If adding new columns doesn't change the span, the original columns already span the space.

title: Checking Linear Independence
